entries.odia: ତୁମ୍ଭେ ତ ଭିତରକୁ ଗଲ ଆମ୍ଭଙ୍କୁ ଦୁଆର ଜଗାଇଲ
entries.title: Inside, and at the door
entries.literal_meaning: You went inside and left us guarding the door.
entries.explanation: The speaker contrasts someone’s entry with the task assigned to those left at the doorway. The dictionary defines setting another person to guard the entrance. Our reading asks how participation and responsibility have been divided. The line does not establish deception, betrayal or an unfair intention; it makes the different positions audible without explaining why they arose.
entries.meaning_odia: ଜଣେ ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବା ଓ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଦୁଆର ଜଗାଇବା କଥା ବକ୍ତା ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶଦ୍ୱାର ରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ରଖାଇବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ ଓ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ କିପରି ବଣ୍ଟା ହେଲା? ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଠକାମି, ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ। ଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନ ଜଣାଯାଏ, କାରଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices a division of roles without inventing its motive.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଭୂମିକାର ବଣ୍ଟନ ଦେଖେ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ସଭା ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଦଳଟି ପାଳିକରି ସ୍ୱାଗତକାମ କରିବାକୁ ଠିକ୍ କଲା, ଯାହାଫଳରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ବସିପାରିବେ। / A group rotates welcoming duties so everyone can join a discussion. This arrangement is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The domestic verb gloss describes an assignment, not a verified incident or universal rule. The speaker’s and addressee’s gender and relationship are not supplied.

entries.odia: ତାକୁ ଭାତ ମକମକଉଛି, ନାଁ ବୟସ ମକମକଉଛି?
entries.title: Rice, or age?
entries.literal_meaning: Is rice making that person impudent, or is age doing it?
entries.explanation: The question offers two explanations for conduct the speaker regards as impudent. That meaning comes from the dictionary’s third sense. Our critical reading pauses before accepting either explanation: a question can carry a judgment without proving its cause. Neither eating rice nor belonging to an age group establishes how someone behaves.
entries.meaning_odia: ବକ୍ତା ଯାହାକୁ ଧୃଷ୍ଟତା ମନେ କରୁଛନ୍ତି, ତାହାର ଦୁଇଟି କାରଣ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ରଖୁଛନ୍ତି। ଏହି ଅର୍ଥ ଅଭିଧାନର ତୃତୀୟ ଅର୍ଥରୁ ଆସେ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ କୌଣସିଟିକୁ ସତ୍ୟ ମାନିବା ଆଗରୁ ଅଟକେ: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ବିଚାର ରହିପାରେ, କିନ୍ତୁ କାରଣର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନଥାଇପାରେ। ଭାତ ଖାଇବା ବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବୟସ ହେବା କାହାର ଆଚରଣ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our response separates the speaker’s accusation from an established cause.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ କାରଣଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ସହକର୍ମୀ କହିଲେ, ବୟସକୁ ଦୋଷ ଦେବା ଆଗରୁ କେଉଁ କଥାରେ ଅସୁବିଧା ହେଲା ସେକଥା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରିବା। / Colleagues discuss the particular words that caused concern instead of blaming an age group. This exchange is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Sense3 is distinct from intoxication and separation in adjacent senses. No gender, age, nutritional effect or established behavioural cause is supplied; the counterreading is editorial.

entries.odia: ଶିଳ ଶିଳପୁଆ ଗଗନେ ଉଡୁଛନ୍ତି' ଶିମିଳି ତୁଳା କହୁଛି ମୋତେ ରଖ୍
entries.title: Heavy stones, and a plea from cotton
entries.literal_meaning: The grinding slab and stone are flying in the sky; silk-cotton fluff says, “Keep me safe.”
entries.explanation: The dictionary places the saying under the figurative sense of heavy things. Even the grinding stones are aloft, while light fluff asks to be kept safe. Our reading follows the contrast: apparent weight or stability has failed, making another’s appeal more striking. The line supplies no storm, agent or answer to that appeal.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଭାରି ବସ୍ତୁର ଲକ୍ଷଣାର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଶିଳ ଶିଳପୁଆ ବି ଉଡ଼ୁଛନ୍ତି, ଆଉ ହାଲୁକା ତୁଳା ତାକୁ ରଖିବାକୁ କହୁଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି ବିପରୀତ ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଧରେ: ଯାହା ଭାରି ବା ସ୍ଥିର ଲାଗୁଥିଲା ତାହା ରହିପାରୁନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ଅନ୍ୟର ଆବେଦନ ଅଧିକ ଆଖିରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଝଡ଼, କର୍ତ୍ତା ବା ଆବେଦନର ଉତ୍ତର କହେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a plea for safety within an impossible contrast.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଅସମ୍ଭବ ଚିତ୍ର ଭିତରେ ସୁରକ୍ଷାର ଆବେଦନ ଶୁଣେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇଟି ବଡ଼ ଯୋଜନା ଅଟକିବା ପରେ ଛୋଟ ଦଳଟି ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ସହାୟତା ଚାହିଲା। ସଭ୍ୟମାନେ ଆବେଦନଟି ଅଲଗା କରି ଶୁଣିଲେ। / After larger plans stall, a small group asks for support. This modern analogy is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Heavy objects and speaking fluff form a figurative image, not a physical event or botanical identification. The source apostrophe and quotation wording remain unchanged.
